dict.string: XonaDosh uses your location only while you use the app, to show nearby housing listings on the map and estimate commute time to your university. / XonaDosh joylashuvingizni faqat ilovadan foydalanganda, yaqin uy-joy e’lonlari va OTMgacha yo‘l vaqtini hisoblash uchun ishlatadi.

XonaDosh does not track you in the background. Location is requested only while the app is open, to show nearby housing on the map and estimate commute time to university. The geolocation library includes Always APIs, but XonaDosh never requests Always authorization. / XonaDosh fonda kuzatmaydi. Joylashuv faqat ilova ochiqligida, xarita va OTM yo‘li uchun so‘raladi.

XonaDosh does not use background location. This key is required because a map library references Always location APIs. The app only reads your position while you are using it, to show nearby listings and commute estimates. / XonaDosh fon joylashuvini ishlatmaydi. Kalit kutubxona talabi uchun; joylashuv faqat ilovadan foydalanganda olinadi.
XonaDosh uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo for a housing listing you are creating. / XonaDosh kamera faqat siz o‘zingiz e’lon uchun rasm olmoqchi bo‘lganingizda so‘raladi.

XonaDosh accesses photos you select so you can attach them to a housing listing. The app does not browse your library in the background. / XonaDosh faqat siz tanlagan rasmlarni e’longa qo‘shish uchun ishlatadi.
